text.en: Clients overwhelmingly praise the veterinarians and hospital staff on Brittmoore Road for their attentive approach and medical expertise. Pet parents frequently commend Dr. Ramien and Dr. Rieman for thorough examinations and responsive consultations. While one owner reported abrupt customer service regarding pricing, the broad consensus highlights supportive and accommodating staff.

Pet owners consistently observe kind and delicate handling of their dogs and cats during exams and procedures. Reviewers note that technicians take special care with small mouths during cleanings and maintain calm environments for sensitive pets. Longtime clients highlight that their pets receive thoughtful and targeted attention throughout routine examinations.

Reviews emphasize successful clinical outcomes across routine wellness, urgent medical care, and specialized procedures. Clients highlight smooth recoveries following dental surgeries and appreciate that serious health concerns are addressed promptly within a day or two. Long-term visitors note that treatments consistently deliver productive health improvements.

q.en: Does Brittmoore Animal Hospital perform pet dental procedures?

a.en: Yes, clients report successful dental treatments, praising the veterinary team for careful handling and smooth post-procedure recoveries.

q.en: How quickly can pets be seen for urgent health concerns?

a.en: Reviewers note that the clinic accommodates urgent appointments quickly, often scheduling visits within twenty-four hours.

q.en: Are pricing terms clearly provided for specialized procedures?

a.en: Most visits proceed smoothly, though a reviewer highlighted unexpected additional fees during canine reproductive procedures.
